note: The Richmond City Charter, section 3.01.1 (Virginia Code Commission charter page, opened), states: 'On the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November 2004, and every four years thereafter, a general election shall be held to elect the mayor.' The term is four years. Mayoral elections therefore fall in 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024 and 2028, and 2010 is not one of these years. The Virginia Department of Elections historical database (search landing page) listed no other Richmond mayor contest, including no special or primary, in the 2010 to 2026 window; that search supports the charter but is not the basis for this status.
